span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Haemoglobin absorbs red light less than shorter wavelengths, so red-shifting the opsin's action spectrum lets usable light reach deeper brain tissue, which is what makes large-volume and transcranial inhibition possible.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A minority of recorded neurons increase firing under illumination because inhibition of upstream neurons removes their drive (network disinhibition), not because the opsin excites them.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: red light reaches deeper because hemoglobin, myoglobin and lipid absorb it less than blue or yellow
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the gain came from two point mutations plus trafficking sequences borrowed from a potassium channel
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: rebound after illumination is attributed variously to hyperpolarisation-activated currents or to chloride accumulation shifting the reversal potential
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ramping the light down rather than switching it off halves the rebound rate and delays it fourfold
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the few neurons that increased firing are attributed to inhibition of upstream neurons rather than a direct effect
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The noninvasive results cannot be shown to be direct rather than mediated by network effects or illumination of superficial apical dendrites.
span.note: what this limits: the noninvasive results specifically: WE CANNOT EXPLICITLY RULE OUT THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE OBSERVED NONINVASIVE RESULTS WERE THE RESULT OF INDIRECT NETWORK ACTIVITY OR APICAL DENDRITIC ILLUMINATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Transcranial illumination cannot be confined to deep tissue with this setup.
span.note: what this limits: any claim of depth-specific inhibition: IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO NONINVASIVELY ILLUMINATE ONLY DEEP VOLUMES WITH OUR EXPERIMENTAL SETUP WITHOUT ALSO TARGETING SURFACE AND INTERMEDIATE LAYERS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Jaws still produces post-illumination rebound spiking, which constrains experimental design.
span.note: what this limits: experimental designs built on this inhibitor: JAWS DOES YIELD POST-ILLUMINATION REBOUND, WHICH LIKELY HAS IMPLICATIONS FOR CAREFUL EXPERIMENT DESIGN
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Experiments were essentially unblinded and unrandomised.
span.note: what this limits: every comparison in the paper: NO BLINDING WAS CARRIED OUT, WITH THE EXCEPTION OF COTRANSFECTED OPSIN-GFP AND TDTOMATO DATA SETS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the method cannot illuminate deep tissue without also illuminating everything above it, so direct deep inhibition cannot be separated from surface or dendritic effects
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as items 0 and 1 - surface and intermediate layers are illuminated too, so deep effects are not isolated
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Jaws produces MORE post-illumination rebound than the inhibitors it replaces
span.note: what this limits: the choice between inhibitors: Quotation withheld - more post-illumination rebound than the tools it replaces
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: myelination still affects light propagation, so red penetrance is not uniform across preparations
span.note: what this limits: the transfer of the penetrance advantage between preparations: MYELINATION MAY STILL AFFECT OPTICAL PROPAGATION IN NEURAL TISSUE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the two beneficial mutations do not transfer to the halorhodopsin they were modelled on, so the engineering is scaffold-specific
span.note: what this limits: the generality of the engineering strategy: THE TWO HOMOLOGOUS POINT MUTATIONS DID NOT ENHANCE THE N. PHARAONIS HALORHODOPSIN - the mutations do not transfer
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: even improved, the restored retinal spiking reaches about 190 Hz against a wild-type range of 15-450 Hz
span.note: what this limits: the vision-restoration claim: THE RESULTANT SPIKING RATES ARE LIMITED TO LESS THAN 200 HZ, SUBSTANTIALLY LESS THAN THE FULL WILD-TYPE RANGE OF 15-450 HZ
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (RE-GROUNDED FROM A NEITHER-ENDPOINT SPAN) · transcranial —contrasted-with→ optical fiber
span.note: RETRACTED: RE-GROUNDED FROM A NEITHER-ENDPOINT SPAN. The old span reported suppression over a distance range. This sentence sets the two delivery methods against each other by name - 'TRANSCRANIAL inhibition ... with a similar efficacy to standard invasive light delivery with a 200-um OPTICAL FIBER'. The contrast is between the methods; the similar efficacy is the finding ABOUT that contrast, not a denial of it. — strength of the relation: 1 — CRITERION: the fibre is the positive control, because its illumination is known to fall off within a few hundred microns
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
